Name: Mearah
ModernLocation: Disputed; proposed sites include Jezzine and Khirbet 'Ara
Description: A place beside the Sidonians named among the land still unconquered in Joshua's old age, from the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah by Sidon.
BiblicalSignificance: Mearah marks the unfinished edge of the conquest: land promised but not yet taken when Joshua was old.
